info.name: JuniorTravels API
info.description: Postman collection for the JuniorTravels command-based backend. Most requests use POST {{base_url}}/ with a Command header. Authenticated requests use Authorization: Bearer {{parent_token}}, {{vendor_token}}, or {{admin_token}}. The collection covers public discovery, parent accounts and children, vendor onboarding, package management, itinerary, tour occurrences, booking, payments, booking updates, and admin review flows.

request.description: Use carefully. For most testing, update status to inactive instead of deleting.
